description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Woodwraith Strangler by exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie token, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
